{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0386","text":"Subject: Kiln 2.0 budget, can we grab an hour Thursday?

Hey all,

Quick one. The Kiln 2.0 numbers came back from the QS on Monday and they're not where we hoped. Steel's up again, and the revised groundworks quote from the subbie is about 11% over what we carried. Before anything goes to the client I'd like us to sit down and work out where we're absorbing it, where we're pushing back, and what (if anything) we value-engineer out.

Thinking Thursday 2-3pm in the site cabin, or dial in here: [link]

Rough plan:
- Wen walks us through the cost report variances (sheet's here: [link])
- Rhys on the groundworks quote and whether we can rebid any of it
- Sam and Aisha, options on the cladding spec. I know you two don't fully agree on this one, which is kind of why I want it in the room
- Grace on contingency: how much we've burned and what's left
- Agree what we take to the client and who drafts it

Delia, I'd love you there too since programme impacts will come up if we start swapping materials.

I know an hour's a chunk of your week. If we don't need it all, I'm happy to let everyone go early. But I'd rather argue it out together once than do six separate phone calls and end up with six versions of the story.

Have a look at the sheet beforehand if you can, even a skim helps.

Cheers,
Callum
Ferraro & Sons"},{"spec_id":"spec_0387","text":"Prairiecrest Hospitality Group: All-Hands, 60 min, ALL STAFF (yes, everyone)

- Mariam"},{"spec_id":"spec_0388","text":"FW: FW: RE: Bakshi account kickoff!!! Sam/Gemma/Yoko/Omar/Arjun/Tariq: 30 min to ACTUALLY decide agenda, owners + date since apparently nobody could in 14 replies!!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0389","text":"Prairievale Site Planning

Organizer: Keiko
Required: Marcus Ferraro, Ulla Yamamoto, Nadia Tanaka, Nils Xu, Arjun Thorne, Valentina Oyelaran, +2

Howdy folks,

Figured it's high time we all pulled up a chair and talked through where we're headed with the Prairievale site. Lots of moving pieces, so let's get the whole crew together, swap notes, and hash out the plan for the next stretch. Bring whatever's on your mind.

Coffee's on me.

Keiko
